title: Excel Macros
description: Test your knowledge of automating tasks with macros in Excel

questions.question: What does the 'Step Into' feature do in VBA debugging?
options: Executes the code line by line
questions.explanation: 'Step Into' allows you to execute the code line by line for debugging purposes.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a VBA data type?
questions.explanation: VBA does not have a 'Table' data type; it uses 'Integer', 'String', 'Boolean', etc.

questions.question: What is a macro in Excel?
options: A recorded sequence of actions to automate tasks
questions.explanation: A macro is a recorded sequence of actions that can be replayed to automate repetitive tasks.

questions.question: Which shortcut opens the VBA editor in Excel?
questions.explanation: Pressing Alt+F11 opens the VBA editor in Excel.

questions.question: How do you record a macro in Excel?
options: Go to the 'Formulas' tab and click 'Macro'
Go to the 'Developer' tab and click 'Record Macro'
Right-click a cell and select 'Record Macro'
questions.explanation: Macros are recorded from the 'Developer' tab by clicking 'Record Macro'.

questions.question: What is the file extension for an Excel macro-enabled workbook?
Which language is used to write Excel macros?
questions.explanation: Excel macros are written in VBA (Visual Basic for Applications).

questions.question: How do you assign a macro to a button in Excel?
options: Insert a button from the 'Developer' tab and assign the macro
Copy and paste the macro into a cell
Use the 'Format' tab to link the macro
Drag the macro onto the worksheet
questions.explanation: Buttons can be inserted from the 'Developer' tab and assigned to macros.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'Personal Macro Workbook'?
options: To store macros that can be used in any workbook
questions.explanation: The 'Personal Macro Workbook' stores macros that are available across all Excel workbooks.

questions.question: What does the 'Run' button do in the VBA editor?
options: Executes the selected macro or code
questions.explanation: The 'Run' button executes the selected macro or VBA code.
